content.title: Subscribe, follow, stay informed
content.summary: The City of Arvada utilizes various communication tools to keep the community informed, including bi-weekly newsletters, project-specific updates, and notifications about service delays and emergencies. Residents can subscribe to multiple newsletters covering topics such as local events, economic development, and specific city projects. Additionally, the city engages with the community through social media platforms like Facebook and Instagram.
content.body:
The City uses a variety of communication tools to help share information with the community.

## Newsletters

![City of Arvada Logo](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=5949)

### [Arvada News](https://www.arvadaco.gov/608/Sign-Up-for-City-Newsletter)

Bi-weekly newsletter with current news and events from the City of Arvada.

### [Utility Bill Insert](https://www.arvadaco.gov/list.aspx?ListID=262)

Bi-monthly newsletter with an e-version of the information shared through the printed City utility bill.

### [SpeakUp Arvada](https://speakup.arvadaco.gov/hub/Subscriptions/4124)

Timely information about engagement opportunities when the City is seeking community input on various projects or services.

### [Majestic View Nature Center](https://signup.e2ma.net/signup/1968633/1717219/)

Twice a month emails about programs, events, and other information about the Majestic View Nature Center.

### [Arvada Economic Development Association (AEDA)](https://signup.e2ma.net/signup/2016791/1704120/)

Monthly updates and tools for local business owners, including events, partner resources and tips for working with the City.

### [City of Arvada Volunteers](https://signup.e2ma.net/signup/2012788/1717219/)

Sign up for the City of Arvada email list to receive updates on City of Arvada volunteer opportunities and events.

### Project Specific Newsletters

- [**Homelessness Response**](https://www.arvadaco.gov/list.aspx?ListID=282)**:** Stay up to date with progress on the City’s response to homelessness including opportunities to attend community meetings, provide feedback, and volunteer.
- [**W. 72nd Avenue Bond Project**](https://app.e2ma.net/app2/audience/signup/1967947/1717219/)**:** Receive updates on the W. 72nd Avenue construction project including impacts for the traveling public.
- [**Gold Strike Park**](https://signup.e2ma.net/signup/1982652/1717219/): Receive updates on the revitalization project of this historical site, home to the first document gold discovery in Colorado.
- [**Marge Roberts Park**](https://signup.e2ma.net/signup/2014692/1717219/): Get the latest updates on the major park overhaul project, including when the park will open and details on a ribbon cutting celebration.
- [**Comprehensive Plan**](https://app.e2ma.net/app2/audience/signup/2101013/1717219/): Sign up for updates on how to get involved in the Comprehensive Plan throughout 2026 and 2027.

## Notifications

![Alerts](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=5142)

- [**Recycling & Trash Delays**](https://www.arvadaco.gov/list.aspx)**:**Receive notifications for City-run recycling & trash service delays.
- [**City Facility Closures**](https://www.arvadaco.gov/list.aspx)**:** Receive notifications for City of Arvada public facility closures.
- [**City Parks Updates**](https://www.arvadaco.gov/CivicAlerts.aspx?CID=8)**:**Receive notifications for weather-related event updates, park projects, renovations, closures and engagement opportunities.

### [Emergency Alerts](https://www.arvadaco.gov/680/Emergency-Notifications)

Sign up for LookOut Alert (Smart 911) to receive alerts for weather and public safety emergencies.

- [**Arvada Report**](/604)**:**view a digital copy of the City's bi-monthly print publication.
- [**Channel 8 - KATV**](/899)**:**watch Arvada's government access channel.
- [**News Releases**](/908)**:**read recent news releases sent to media organizations.
